backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features with associated file paths, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for site-wide phone number unification, navigation menu structure, and SEO page components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short descriptions summarizing each file's purpose, used as a build planning reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind layers and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Gadget Zone SPA with SEO meta tags, Open Graph tags, LocalBusiness JSON-LD structured data, GA4 tracking, and Google Ads conversion script for the Thiruvanmiyur Chennai mobile store.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers full site access and pointing to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing all public URLs for the Gadget Zone site including product brand pages, service sub-pages, about pages, contact, and policy pages with priorities and change frequencies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root SPA component that manages client-side routing via pushState, initializes analytics tracking, and renders the correct page component for each registered route including product, service, and about sub-pages.
frontend/src/components/BusinessHighligh: Renders a 4-column strip displaying key business info (location, hours, phone, WhatsApp) with icons, links, and Google Ads conversion tracking on call/WhatsApp clicks.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social links (WhatsApp, Instagram), quick navigation links, service links, policy links, and contact details; supports custom navigation via onNavigate prop.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky site header with logo, multi-level dropdown navigation, mobile hamburger menu, scroll-aware styling, active route highlighting, and a call CTA with conversion tracking.
frontend/src/components/HotFab.tsx: A fixed floating action button that scrolls the user to the HOT PICK section when clicked, styled with a red-to-orange gradient.
frontend/src/components/HotPickSection.t: Promotional section highlighting the Motorola Signature as the featured 'HOT PICK' device, with product image, key highlights, and Call/WhatsApp CTA buttons with conversion tracking.
frontend/src/components/MobileCareSmartU: Displays a paginated list of 25 mobile care tips, showing 8 by default with a 'Show more' button that opens a scrollable modal dialog containing all tips.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: An image component that renders a fallback UI (text or camera icon placeholder) when the image fails to load, with support for logo and card fallback styles.
frontend/src/components/TickerBanner.tsx: A horizontally scrolling ticker banner that displays a repeated list of product/service categories using CSS animation.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppQuickMes: A React component that renders a WhatsApp button with a popover offering three pre-written quick message options, each linking to wa.me with the encoded message and firing a Google Ads conversion event on click.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates all non-actor queries whenever the actor instance changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for ICP apps, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for background textures, ticker banner animation, and HOT badge pulse animation.
frontend/src/lib/analyticsConfig.ts: Exports a single analytics configuration object with GTM container ID (from env variable) and a hardcoded GA4 measurement ID, with enabled flags for each service.
frontend/src/lib/assetVersion.ts: Exports a version constant and a helper function that appends a version query string to asset URLs for cache-busting.
frontend/src/lib/clickTracking.ts: Implements delegated click tracking on the document that fires GA4 events for context-specific CTA clicks (via data attributes), WhatsApp links, and tel links, initializing only once.
frontend/src/lib/ga4.ts: Provides safe wrapper functions for sending GA4 custom events and page views via gtag, no-opping gracefully when GA4 is unavailable or not configured.
frontend/src/lib/googleAdsTracking.ts: Exports helper functions that fire Google Ads gtag conversion events for leads, contact form submissions, WhatsApp clicks, and call clicks, using a hardcoded Ads account ID.
frontend/src/lib/googleTracking.ts: Provides idempotent initialization functions for Google Tag Manager (script injection) and GA4 (no-op, loaded from index.html head), with a combined initializeTracking entry point.
frontend/src/lib/scrollDepthTracking.ts: Tracks scroll depth at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% thresholds using passive scroll listeners and requestAnimationFrame throttling, firing GA4 events once per threshold per page load.
frontend/src/lib/seoHelpers.ts: Provides utility functions to dynamically update page meta tags (title, description, Open Graph, Twitter, canonical) for SEO on route changes in a SPA.
frontend/src/lib/spaPageViews.ts: Patches history.pushState and history.replaceState and listens to popstate to send GA4 page_view events on SPA navigation.
frontend/src/lib/structuredData.ts: Generates and injects JSON-LD structured data schemas (LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) into the document head for schema.org markup.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/about/StoryPage.tsx: Renders the 'Our Story' page for Gadget Zone Chennai, detailing the shop's founding history and growth milestones with SEO metadata, breadcrumb structured data, and call/WhatsApp CTA buttons.
frontend/src/pages/about/WhyChooseUsPage: Renders the 'Why Choose Us' page listing six key advantages (authorized dealer, genuine products, expert service, pricing, EMI, customer satisfaction) with SEO setup and contact CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component displaying Gadget Zone's story, values, and gallery, with SEO meta updates and LocalBusiness/Breadcrumb structured data injection on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page with a WhatsApp-linked contact form, call/WhatsApp buttons, and store info, tracking conversions via Google Ads and GA4 on interactions.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page displaying a hero section, service cards, brand logos, and trust indicators for Gadget Zone, with SEO updates and LocalBusiness structured data injected on mount.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the Privacy Policy page for Gadget Zone, covering data collection, Google Analytics/Ads usage, cookies, and user rights, with SEO metadata set on mount.
frontend/src/pages/products/ApplePage.ts: Renders the Apple products page for Gadget Zone Chennai, showcasing iPhone and iPad models available with SEO metadata, breadcrumb schema, and call/WhatsApp inquiry buttons.
frontend/src/pages/products/MotorolaPage: Renders the Motorola smartphones page covering Edge, G-series, and Razr models with SEO metadata, breadcrumb structured data, and call/WhatsApp CTA buttons.
Renders the OnePlus smartphones page highlighting flagship and Nord series with SEO metadata, breadcrumb schema, and call/WhatsApp inquiry CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/products/RealmePage.t: Product page for Realme smartphones at Gadget Zone Chennai, displaying brand info, series sections, and call/WhatsApp CTA buttons with SEO and breadcrumb structured data setup.
Product page for Samsung Galaxy phones at Gadget Zone Chennai, covering S/A/M series with call/WhatsApp CTAs, SEO metadata, and breadcrumb structured data injection.
frontend/src/pages/products/VivoPage.tsx: Product page for Vivo smartphones at Gadget Zone Chennai, highlighting V-series and Y-series camera phones with call/WhatsApp CTAs and SEO/breadcrumb setup.
frontend/src/pages/products/XiaomiPage.t: Product page for Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones at Gadget Zone Chennai, showcasing flagship and budget series with call/WhatsApp CTAs and SEO/breadcrumb structured data.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Displays a filterable brand catalog (Apple, Samsung, Motorola, etc.) with category filters, WhatsApp/call CTAs, and SEO/structured data setup for the products listing page.
frontend/src/pages/RefundPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the Refund Policy page detailing return eligibility, non-returnable items, refund process, and timelines, with SEO metadata set on mount.
frontend/src/pages/services/AccessoriesP: Service page listing mobile accessories categories (cases, chargers, power banks, earphones, speakers, etc.) available at Gadget Zone Chennai, with call/WhatsApp CTAs and SEO/breadcrumb setup.
frontend/src/pages/services/CCTVPage.tsx: Service detail page for CCTV sales and installation, including SEO setup, breadcrumb structured data, and call/WhatsApp conversion tracking buttons.
frontend/src/pages/services/EMIPage.tsx: Service detail page for EMI and finance options for smartphones, with SEO metadata, breadcrumb schema injection, and phone/WhatsApp CTA buttons.
frontend/src/pages/services/ExchangePage: Service detail page for the mobile exchange and upgrade program, handling SEO, breadcrumb structured data, and call/WhatsApp conversion tracking.
frontend/src/pages/services/RepairPage.t: Service detail page for mobile repair services listing repair types with estimated times, SEO configuration, breadcrumb schema, and call/WhatsApp CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Displays all Gadget Zone services (new mobiles, repair, exchange, accessories, CCTV, EMI) as cards with images, feature lists, and WhatsApp/call CTAs, with SEO and structured data setup.
frontend/src/pages/TermsOfServicePage.ts: Renders the Terms of Service page covering purchase terms, warranty, repair conditions, exchange policy, and liability limitations, with SEO metadata set on mount.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with oklch-based design tokens for colors, custom border radii, font family, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the Gadget Zone website project state including architectural rules (unified phone number 919840077591, SPA routing, SEO), existing features, and known issues across schema version 1.0.0.
